query: I’m evaluating a 72-year-old man. Among male ICU stays aged 67–77, what percentile is a per-stay average temperature of 36.0°C measured over the first 24 hours?
final_sql: SELECT percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT AVG(value) FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 101 AND subject_id = 757071 AND charttime BETWEEN 0 AND 24)) AS percentile_rank FROM labevents WHERE itemid = 101 AND subject_id = 757071 AND charttime BETWEEN 0 AND 24;
